plugins.name: GlowFX
plugins.description: One-click procedural holographic glow for items and logos: rainbow rays, lens flares, star sparkles and halo rings that follow the item's shape.

notes: Holo Glow is now called GlowFX.
Glow layers you made before the rename still update when you click Apply again.
🎲 Shuffle now changes the colour too: a different palette and a slight hue shift each time.
The ✨ plugin icon now shows up in Photoshop.
The panel now shows the plugin version at the bottom.
A "What's new" box appears the first time you open the panel after an update.
Radius slider now runs 1–100 and starts small (10), so the glow sits close to the item.
The panel scrolls, so all Advanced settings are reachable.
New Glow type picker: Holo Burst, Lens Flare, Star Sparkle, Prism Bloom, Pearl Haze, Rainbow Halo.
Rays now follow the item's shape (new Shape follow slider).
New gray ✨ panel icon for light and dark themes.
Soft rainbow lens-halo ring around the item, with Ring size and width controls.
Fixed thin transparent lines that could appear in the glow.
First release: one-click procedural holographic glow with radius, intensity and colour controls.
